text:
[LGRA.10.3.1] Action-argument productions:

```
action_arg ::= kwarg | flag

kwarg ::= NAME ':' value
flag  ::= NAME

value ::= expression
```

Literals (INT_LIT, FLOAT_LIT, STRING_LIT, UNIT_LIT, BOOL_LIT) and
`NAME` are subsumed by `expression` — `literal` is a primary,
`NAME` is a primary alternative.
